observations: Photo 0: A large truck cab (blue/white) with a flatbed/industrial chassis; front wheel area looks heavily worn/rusted; truck appears stationary outdoors behind a fence.
Photo 1: A long container/box section in yellow and white panels (looks like a cargo container or industrial body) with visible dents, rust, and missing/loose parts.
Photo 2: Another angle showing a white/gray truck cab with a front grille and headlights; body/bed looks stripped/aged; multiple trucks/units visible in the yard.

claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show vehicles/industrial units in a yard but do not confirm the business model or location coverage.

claims.claim: at huzhak steel company ltd, we deal in all kinds of industrial...
claims.evidence: Seller text only; no readable signage/receipt/contract in photos to confirm the named company or the exact inventory.

risks.risk: Exact item for sale is unclear (whole truck vs parts vs scrap container/body). Photos show multiple vehicles/units in a yard.
risks.proof: Ask for a single clear photo of the exact unit being sold with a tag/label showing the lot number, plus a wide shot that includes the same unit’s full identity (cab + bed/container).
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/parts only (worst case: not a complete, usable truck).

risks.risk: Condition/operability unknown (engine, gearbox, hydraulics, brakes). Photos show heavy wear and likely non-running status.
risks.proof: Request a short video clip of the engine starting (or at least cranking) and a walk-around showing key components (battery area, dashboard, exhaust, brake lines).

risks.risk: Ownership/legality risk (scrap yards sometimes sell without clear documentation).
risks.proof: Request proof of ownership or sale document (e.g., invoice/letter of disposal) and the vehicle/container identification plate/serial number photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price at scrap-only level due to potential inability to register/transfer.

risks.risk: Missing parts and damage level unknown (container/bed panels appear dented; cab components may be stripped).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the front (radiator area), chassis rails, wheels/axles, and the container/bed doors/locks showing what is missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete with unknown missing parts.

risks.risk: Model/brand not readable, so wrong scrap valuation/comparables could be used.
risks.proof: Request photos of the truck’s make/model plate and VIN/serial plate (clear, readable), plus the container/box identification plate if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price using generic scrap/industrial body value assumptions (worst case).

proof_requests: Confirm what exactly is being sold: whole truck, container/body, or scrap lot (and whether it’s one unit or multiple).
Provide readable VIN/serial/ID plate photos for the exact unit.
Provide a video showing engine start/crank (or confirm explicitly that it’s non-running) and a walk-around of major components.
Provide proof of ownership/disposal (invoice/letter) for Lagos transfer.
response.reason: The photos show multiple damaged industrial vehicles/units in a yard, but the exact item, its identity (make/model/serial), and operability/ownership are not verifiable from the images. Without that, a worst-case price cannot be confidently set.
